## Episode Thesis

This episode of the Danish show Store Penge features Pelle Dragsted, political spokesperson for Enhedslisten. It is mostly political: European digital dependence on US tech giants (Palantir, Microsoft), AI risks and the case for regulating data centres, and a critique of the new Danish tax agreement that cuts corporate tax from 22% to 19% and raises the aktiesparekonto cap. The tone toward big tech is critical. There are no stock recommendations beyond Dragsted's general advice to own broad index funds and his scepticism toward crypto.
